   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK SENIOR CITIZENS COMMISSION
  April 10, 2024

The meeting was called to order by Commissioner Chair Esperanza Serrano at 3:07
p.m. at the Norwalk Senior Center, 14040 San Antonio Drive, Norwalk, California.
Responding to roll call were Senior Citizens Commission members Rachel Contreras,
Helen Diosdado, Martha Mesa and Esperanza Serrano. Staff present Interim Senior
Center Manager Daniel Abrego, Social Services Coordinator Lucy Santamaria, Transit
Administrative Specialist Maria Corona and Office Assistant II Albertina Arzate.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Commissioner Mesa moved to approve the minutes of the March 13, 2024, regular
meeting. Commissioner Diosdado seconded the motion to approve the minutes, motion
carried.

REPORTS

Comment Form Summary
Interim Senior Center Manager Abrego reported receiving comments regarding menu
items for the nutrition program and another comment received which praised both the
Senior Center’s movie night feature, “The Holdovers” and the Elvis Impersonator at the
Social Services Facility.

Dial-A-Ride Program
Transit Administrative Specialist Maria Corona addressed any concerns and provided
an update on the Dial-A-Ride program and the Taxi Program. An explanation of the
program policies and procedures was given. Commissioners shared the positive
experiences they have had utilizing Dial-A-Ride.

Norwalk Older American Nominee
Interim Manager Abrego shared the name of the chosen nominee, the upcoming event
recognition details and thanked the Commissioners on voting.

Norwalk High School Choir and Jazz Band
Interim Manager Abrego shared details of the program and invited commissioners to
attend.

Health and Wellness Week
Social Services Coordinator Santamaria shared details of the upcoming event, provided
a flyer with details on all the activities, invited commissioners to attend and encouraged
commissioners to extend the invitation to seniors throughout the community.

Mayor’s Prayer Breakfast
Interim Manager Abrego shared details of the program and invited commissioners to
attend.

STAFF COMMENTS
Interim Manager Abrego and Social Services Coordinator Santamaria reported on

upcoming center activities. Interim Manager Abrego shared the flyer-invitation for the
upcoming Commission Meet and Greet and encouraged the Commissioners to rsvp and
attend.

COMMISSIONER’S COMMENTS
Commissioner Mesa complimented the Elvis impersonator presented at the Social
Services Facility, enjoyed the Bunny Palooza held at the Senior Center, and made a
few suggestions on the basket decorating during the Bunny Palooza. Commissioner
Mesa shared that the Parkinson’s Disease Presentation was very informative and
important and that she will continue advocating for seniors to attend these valuable
presentations. Lastly, she shared the concern with the limited parking spaces at the
Senior Center and her concern for the seniors having to park far from the center. Interim
Manager Abrego responded that staff will continue to contact Public Safety to monitor
the neighboring streets and as the seniors depart from events. Commissioner Diosdado
shared how happy she is with all the citywide events and on the importance and value
of the Health and Wellness Week. She shared a story on how a screening she attended
helped her look into a medical condition she otherwise would not have known about.
Commissioner Diosdado is looking forward to the upcoming Meet and Greet with other
City Commissions. Commissioner Serrano reported that she looks forward to visiting the
Senior Center more often and this makes her happy as well as seeing the community
come together at the wonderful citywide events. She commends all City Staff on all they
do for the community and Public Safety for patrolling and keeping residents safe.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Cynthia Clemente spoke.

ADJOURNMENT
There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 3:55 p.m.

______________________________
Esperanza Serrano, Chair
Norwalk Senior Commission
